descriptionChirho: A proper name used for multiple individuals and one geographic region in the Hebrew Bible: (1) a concubine of Caleb (1 Chronicles 2:48); (2) the wife of Machir (1 Chronicles 7:15-16); (3) the mother of Absalom and daughter of Talmai king of Geshur (2 Samuel 3:3; 1 Chronicles 3:2); (4) the father of Achish king of Gath (1 Kings 2:39); (5) the wife/mother of Rehoboam/Abijam (1 Kings 15:2, 10, 13; 2 Chronicles 11:20-22, 13:2, 15:16); (6) the father of Hanan (1 Chronicles 11:43); (7) the father of Shephatiah (1 Chronicles 27:16); (8) an Aramean kingdom near Hermon (2 Samuel 10:6-8; 1 Chronicles 19:6-7). Transliterations: Arabic مَعْكَة (Ma'kah), Spanish 'Maaca/Maacah', Hindi माकाह/माका (Maakah/Maaka), Korean 마아가 (Maaga), Swahili 'Maaka'. All clusters (bare name, with conjunctive waw) are inflectional, not semantic distinctions.
